title: every hollow worktree has the commons beside it
intention: The hollow's scratch worktree always has CairnCommons beside it, so a proof that reads ../CairnCommons measures the same world in the hollow as on the house checkout. A ticket that names no commons file gets the standing commons, read only and never reverted. A ticket that names a commons file keeps the commons worktree b312ff041558 built.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: ad6f3d0b265c's hollow refused with 'no reversion reading can be attributed to a file', because two teeth fail at HEAD in the scratch worktree (test_the_word_answers_the_map_and_refuses_a_non_status_verb, test_live_one_label_per_id_across_the_three_reports): the worktree has no CairnCommons sibling. 207c4074b3d5's test_each_run_tickets_its_new_reds_and_orphans passes only with a commons beside it, and 4d8a2c6e91f7's proof copies the live tickets charter from ../CairnCommons. hollow.py:1083 places the sibling only when the ticket names a commons file.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: the hollow must measure the build, not a missing sibling); Law 3.
how: In hollow.py, when the ticket names no commons file, symlink <worktree parent>/CairnCommons to the standing commons. When it names one, keep the commons worktree as it is.

clauses.claim: a hollow over a ticket naming no commons file runs its proofs in a worktree whose parent holds CairnCommons resolving to the standing commons, so a tooth that reads ../CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json is green at the baseline and a reversion of the built file is attributed
a hollow over a ticket naming a commons file still reverts that file in a commons worktree beside the repo worktree, as test_the_hollow_reverts_a_commons_file measures
the standing commons is byte-identical before and after a hollow over a ticket naming no commons file

decisions.text: D1: hollow.py's commons-beside block (~line 1083) places <wt.parent>/CairnCommons for every run: a commons worktree when the ticket names a tracked commons file (as now), else a symlink to commons.resolve(). The comment's 'every other run measures exactly what it measured before' is replaced by the measured reason.
D2: the proof builds a scratch repo + scratch commons pair, a ticket whose built file a proof tooth reads beside a commons read, runs the hollow, one tooth per clause.

out: every proof that reads the commons (they stay as written)

measured.saw: ad6f hollow: two teeth fail at HEAD in /tmp/cairn-hollow-scratch.*/worktree, which has no CairnCommons sibling; hollow.py:1083 places one only when cfiles is non-empty
measured.how: akiendelllinux_cc_0's read of the ad6f hollow, relayed 2026-11-14; hollow.py read at 4cfce3a7d
